newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures higher, some cut gains.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures higher, some cut gains.

text.p: July 8 - U.S. stock index futures were up in early afternoon, though some contracts had cut gains. Sept S&P 500 drifted down from its 926.50 session high and fell through intraday support at 924.50. Monday's low at 915.85 remains support, traders said. Redbook reported retail sales up 1.7 pct in June.
